algorithms.name: Binary search in a sorted array

es.explanation: Cada comparación parte el rango a la mitad.

algorithms.name: Binary search on the answer over [0, R], with an O(n) check
algorithms.explanation: log R rounds, each running the check once.

es.explanation: log R rondas, y en cada una se corre el chequeo una vez.

algorithms.name: Merge sort
algorithms.explanation: log n levels of halving, and merging one whole level costs O(n).

es.explanation: log n niveles de partir a la mitad, y mezclar un nivel entero cuesta O(n).

algorithms.name: Quickselect for the k-th smallest element (expected time)
algorithms.explanation: Each round keeps one side of a random pivot, so the expected work is n + n/2 + n/4 + … = O(n).

es.explanation: Cada ronda se queda con un lado de un pivote aleatorio, así que el trabajo esperado es n + n/2 + n/4 + … = O(n).

algorithms.name: Ternary search for the minimum of a convex function over n integers, O(1) per evaluation
algorithms.explanation: Each step drops a third of the range, which still means O(log n) steps.

es.explanation: Cada paso descarta un tercio del rango, lo que igual da O(log n) pasos.

algorithms.name: Subset sum by meet in the middle (sort one half's sums, binary search from the other)
algorithms.explanation: Each half has 2^(n/2) sums; sorting them costs 2^(n/2) · log 2^(n/2) = O(2^(n/2) · n).

es.explanation: Cada mitad tiene 2^(n/2) sumas; ordenarlas cuesta 2^(n/2) · log 2^(n/2) = O(2^(n/2) · n).

algorithms.name: Two pointers over an already sorted array (e.g. pairs with sum ≤ x)
algorithms.explanation: Each pointer only moves in one direction, so there are at most 2n moves.

es.explanation: Cada puntero se mueve en una sola dirección, así que hay a lo sumo 2n movimientos.

algorithms.name: Parallel binary search: q queries over m updates, replaying the updates once per round
algorithms.explanation: log m rounds; each round replays the m updates once and checks every query once.

es.explanation: log m rondas; en cada una se repiten las m actualizaciones una vez y se chequea cada consulta una vez.

algorithms.name: Karatsuba multiplication of two n-digit numbers
algorithms.explanation: Three half-size multiplications instead of four: T(n) = 3T(n/2) + O(n).

es.explanation: Tres multiplicaciones de la mitad de tamaño en vez de cuatro: T(n) = 3T(n/2) + O(n).
